seed: Assume some mechanic is not a function of the visible state, for example a turn order, a patrol route or a hidden counter. Carry hidden state across calls, gated on continuity.

synth.notes:
Player 5x5 moves 5 cells per arrow; dest blocked if off-board or any wall 4 / void 5 cell (blocked moves still burn the bar).
A 5-cell colour-1 strip just outside a dest edge is a conveyor that slides the player away until blocked.
step_bar burns its 2 leftmost 11 cells (to 3) per arrow; covering a ring refills the bar.
Covering a collect object rotates the HUD glyph 90 deg CW; the covered sprite is restored on leaving (hidden underlay memory, gated on exact frame continuity).
Turn-order/patrol/counter hypothesis not needed: the only hidden state is the underlay. Chamber/recolor behaviour unobserved.
